# R2: __contains__

print('R2 not contains:', 'xyz' in r)

# R3: brace validation
try:
    parse.parse('{unclosed', 'text')
    print('R3: FAIL - no error')
except ValueError as e:
    print('R3: ValueError -', e)

# R4: FixedTzOffset
tz = parse.FixedTzOffset('+0500', '+0500')

results_ci = list(parse.findall('{name:w}', 'Hello hello HELLO'))
print('R8 case_insensitive (3 results):', len(results_ci))

# R9: left alignment consuming up to next space
r = parse.parse('{:l}', 'hello')
print('R9 left align:', repr(r[0]) if r else 'FAIL')
